label: TP
reason: User-controlled data from request cookies (specifically cookie values retrieved via getValue()) is written directly into the HTML response without sanitization. Although HttpOnly is set, this mitigates JS access to the cookie storage but does not prevent XSS when the cookie value is echoed back into the HTML body.

evidence.note: Cookie value obtained from request.getCookies() is included in response.getWriter() output without HTML encoding.
Data flow from user-provided cookie name/value to response sink identified by CodeQL.
